fields.Name: Shelter Dashboard Stats
fields.UserQuestion: What are the shelter's headline numbers right now?
fields.Description: Every scalar the shelter dashboard shows, in one row: animals in care, how many are housed, total active capacity, overdue follow-ups, and how many animals in care have a vaccination on file. Aggregated on the server -- these are computed values, not entity records.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Returns ONE row: AnimalsInCare, Housed, Capacity, OverdueFollowUps, VaccinatedInCare. No parameters. Uses scalar subqueries rather than CTEs because MJ wraps a Query in 'WITH [__count] AS ( ... )' and T-SQL cannot nest a CTE inside another CTE's body; for the same wrapper there is no ORDER BY, and the schema is written literally as __mj because metadata files are not flyway-processed. 'In care' is Intake/Available/Hold -- an Adopted animal may still carry an old HousingID and would otherwise report a kennel as full.
